description.value:
An Action and 1 minute turn a non-hovering, non-smart grenade into a Homing grenade (no launcher). Thrown, it hovers over its square for the rest of the Round, scanning a 14×14m area (through smoke, glass and darkness, not roofs) for the biggest threat to you, friend or foe. Next Round it flies over cover at that target and detonates. Dodging it takes DV17 Evasion. While it hovers, an Aimed Shot detonates it harmlessly.

Cost: 250eb (Expensive) for 1

Item Compendium (2070) • Ammo & Explosives
